paragraphs: TCP Software sells scheduling, time, and attendance solutions to organizations of any size or sector. The range covers automated time and attendance, employee scheduling, time clock hardware, and integrations for ERP, HCM, and payroll systems. TimeClock Plus covers time tracking, leave and accrual management, and K-12 resource management.

Humanity Schedule builds and adjusts shifts automatically, using AI to forecast demand and match qualified staff to shifts. It connects to payroll, ERP, or HCM software from providers including ADP, Oracle, Workday, and BambooHR, or through an open API. Humanity Time is offered to smaller teams for tracking time, attendance, and labor costs.

Aladtec is the public safety product, sold for 24/7 rotational scheduling to fire, EMS, law enforcement, and corrections agencies. Its schedules carry work, union, and fatigue rules so that an agency can answer an audit.

quote.text: 24/7 automated staff scheduling built for the unique rotation patterns and union policies of public safety and government agencies.
